body:
(
  search_dir="${1|/path/to/directory/,${pathToDirectory}|}"
  if [ -z "$search_dir" ]; then
    printf '%s\n' 'find: empty search directory' >&2
    exit 2
  fi
  case $search_dir in
    -*) search_dir=./$search_dir ;;
  esac
  if [ ! -d "$search_dir" ] || [ ! -r "$search_dir" ] || [ ! -x "$search_dir" ]; then
    printf '%s\n' 'find: search directory is unavailable' >&2
    exit 2
  fi
  CDPATH='' cd -P "$search_dir" || exit 2
  status=0
  for entry in ./*; do
    if [ ! -e "$entry" ] && [ ! -L "$entry" ]; then
      continue
    fi
    find "$entry" -type ${2|f,d|} -mtime ${3|-,+|}${4:days} -delete || status=$?
  done
  exit "$status"
)
description: find and remove files(f)/directories(d) older(+)/newer(-) than x days
